conditions: Credit Open Prices/Open Food Facts and retain source/license notices.
Publicly used derivative databases must use ODbL/later similar or compatible license (4.4).
Offer the derivative database or alterations/method in machine-readable form for public use as applicable (4.6).
Do not combine incompatible non-free commercial data in an ODbL derived database; separate source snapshots and legal scopes.
Database ODbL does not itself grant image/individual contents rights; no proof photos were downloaded or republished.

limits: Counts are for the public API and daily export snapshot at recorded times, not a guarantee about all unpublished, future, deleted or unlocatable contributions.
Recent window uses observation dates 2026-11-07 through 2026-11-13 inclusive; update date and proof creation date do not substitute for observation date.
Circle can include sea or part of another island; every one of the 27 returned rows was cross-checked against location coordinates, ES country, Tenerife postal scope and place metadata.

Daily locations export last-modified 2026-11-12 23:11:30 UTC; its seven Tenerife candidates and summed 27 price_count match live results. Newly added unlocated places outside this snapshot are not inferred.
Postal digits alone are insufficient: 259 foreign locations share 38000–38699; country and coordinates were checked.
Zero observed usable prices is not a claim that supermarkets have zero products or that every possible source has no prices.
This audit does not approve B06.2 implementation or a local cheapest-basket claim.
